summary: Comprehensive validation of Moonlight Neurocare login redesign + admin live editor. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases passed (password login for admin/staff/parent, wrong-password 401, /auth/demo, PATCH /admin/content auth/CSRF/role gates, invalid key 422, single-key persistence to /public/settings, multi-key edits). Frontend: full Playwright coverage of login page redesign, role-card auto-fill, submit redirects (admin->/portal/admin/overview, staff->/portal/staff/today, parent->/portal/parent/today), one-click enter-demo variants for all three roles, admin-edit-website launch button, live-editor-bar visibility on /?edit=1, inline edit of data-ml-key=home-hero-title-1 persisting after reload, edit-mode preference persisted via localStorage (bar remains after reload), live-editor-done turns it off, and access control (no live-editor-launch/bar for logged-out users OR logged-in staff). login-back-home link returns to '/'.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py:278 logout uses response.delete_cookie(secure=True, httponly=True, samesite='lax') — some browsers ignore the delete if attributes mismatch the set-cookie; verify Set-Cookie deletion is honored in production. Minor.

editor endpoint stores content on settings doc and increments version but /admin/settings PATCH uses optimistic concurrency on version — concurrent live-edits could bump version and cause 409 on settings save. Consider isolating content edits from settings version. Non-blocking.
security.py rate_limit uses 10-min windows for login (max 8). Fine for demo but no bruteforce lockout after N fails (only window cap). Non-blocking for demo mode.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds per-browser sandbox via seed_demo() on /auth/login and /auth/demo. Public /public/settings creates sandbox cookie.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests need REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and WEB_ORIGIN env vars exported before pytest run. Same-origin PATCH from browser is fine; raw curl needs Origin header. Editing an Editable element requires clicking to enter contentEditable mode, then blur (click elsewhere) triggers PATCH /api/admin/content.
